issues.description: sample_rate is cast to STTAudioFormat via f-string with no validation against the Literal set.
issues.detail: STTAudioFormat enumerates six pcm_* literals, but __init__ uses typing.cast on f"pcm_{sample_rate}", bypassing the type contract. Passing sample_rate=11025 or 32000 silently produces an invalid format string the server will reject. Validate sample_rate against the allowed set at construction and raise immediately, or accept audio_format directly.

issues.description: STTv2.recognize raises NotImplementedError, violating the STT supertype contract.
issues.detail: The STT supertype promises _recognize_impl returns a SpeechEvent. STTv2 weakens postconditions by raising, breaking substitutability. Any caller treating STTv2 as STT may break unexpectedly. Either widen the supertype to express streaming-only capability or implement recognize as a single-shot stream consumption.

issues.description: Documented VAD/duration parameter ranges are not enforced as preconditions.
issues.detail: The docstring asserts vad_silence_threshold_secs in [0.3, 3.0], vad_threshold in [0.1, 0.9], and duration fields in [50, 2000], but __init__ performs no validation. Out-of-range values fail opaquely after WebSocket connect with a server error. Validate at construction and raise ValueError with the actual bounds.

issues.description: Reconnect scaffolding is dead code; nothing sets _reconnect_event on task failure.
issues.detail: The outer while True loop only re-iterates when _reconnect_event fires, but no path sets it on send/recv failure. When tasks raise, task.result() re-raises and the function exits — a transient network blip kills the stream. Wire reconnect on failure or delete the scaffolding. Compounded by recv_task's bare except swallowing APIConnectionError and spinning on a dead session.

issues.description: _speaking state machine relies on empty-commit terminator with no fallback or invariant.
issues.detail: The protocol uses an empty committed_transcript as end-of-segment; a non-empty commit keeps _speaking=True. If the server skips the empty terminator (drop, reconnect, error), _speaking sticks and END_OF_SPEECH never fires. _reconnect_event also does not reset it. State the invariant explicitly and add a timeout-based fallback or reset on reconnect.

issues.description: No tests added for a stateful streaming protocol.
issues.detail: A WebSocket streaming protocol with partial/committed/empty-commit transitions and a _speaking flag is exactly what regresses silently. The 'Deepgram skipped tests' justification is not a reason. Add a focused unit test feeding canned WS messages through _process_stream_event and asserting the emitted event sequence.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The PR adds a streaming Scribe v2 client with the right shape, but ships two blocking issues: sample_rate is cast into the STTAudioFormat Literal without validation (producing invalid pcm_ strings the server rejects), and STTv2.recognize raises NotImplementedError in violation of the STT supertype contract. Documented VAD/duration parameter ranges are not enforced, reconnect scaffolding is dead code with no trigger on task failure, and the _speaking state machine depends on an empty-commit terminator with no fallback. No tests were added for a stateful streaming protocol where regressions are easy to miss.
